species_habitat_vibe.description: Ensures the legal penalty applies to a species actually present in the report region.
species_habitat_vibe.fail_message: Species Mismatch: Legal penalty assumes species {jud_species} but habitat data shows {cli_species}.

thermal_activity_check.description: Ensures thermal signatures exist for the alleged trespassing date.
thermal_activity_check.fail_message: Activity Conflict: No corroborating remote sensing data for the alleged incident date.

temporal_alignment.description: Cross-verifies incident timestamps between monitoring logs and legal filings.
temporal_alignment.fail_message: Temporal Mismatch: Monitoring logs indicate activity at {mon_time} but incident report specifies {inc_time}.

jurisdictional_check.description: Validates that the matched legal provision applies to the specific GPS coordinates provided.
jurisdictional_check.fail_message: Jurisdiction Error: GPS coordinates {lat},{lon} fall outside the legislative scope of {act_name}.

impact_consensus.description: Ensures climate impact assessment (CO2 loss) broadly aligns with tree count from incident analysis.
impact_consensus.fail_message: Impact Variance: Climate loss projection ({cli_loss}) is statistically inconsistent with reported tree count ({inc_count}).
